title: Horimiya
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kyouko Hori, a popular and seemingly perfect student, and Izumi Miyamura, a quiet, gloomy classmate, each have a different self outside school. They discover each other's hidden sides, fall in love, and the story follows their relationship and their friends' lives.
life_message: It holds up being known and loved for who you really are, in friendship, family and romance.
